name: butler_dance
about: The butlers' dance behind him: two bars, hop on beat 1, hop on beat 3, bow across the second bar. Their rig can't take human mocap, so this is the butler's own keyed clips in a beat pattern, one clip for a whole crowd so a row stays in unison. Repeat every 2 bars; start it on a bar line. `stagger` is seconds between members, for a wave.
